Name: Tomb of Javindi Bibi
_why: Corrects one cell. The row's `Sufi Saint` currently reads 'Jalaluddin Surkh-Posh Bukhari' — byte-identical to the cell on 'Shrine of Jalaluddin Surkh-Posh Bukhari', a different monument about a different person — so the knowledge graph filed a woman's tomb as one of his two shrines and the shrine page printed his name on her page. Nothing here is invented: the sheet already contradicts that cell in three of its own columns. `principal_figure` reads 'Bibi Jawindi'; `figure_type` reads 'Historical person' where his row reads 'Sufi saint'; and `figure_born`/`figure_died` (1192/1291) appear on his row only, not hers. This patch adopts what the newer, curated columns already say. Independent of the open `Sufi Saint` vs `principal_figure` column decision — whichever way that goes, this cell is about the wrong person. Once imported, delete the `tomb-of-javindi-bibi` entry from `saintFigureByShrine` in data/kg-seeds.json; `validate-kg-identity.mjs` check 8 fails until you do, so the bridge cannot outlive the fix.
